## 概述

开发服务器是前端工程化链路中的关键一环。理解如何使用 Node.js 原生 `http` 模块构建静态文件服务器、处理 MIME 类型和路由分发，是掌握 Vite/webpack-dev-server 等高级工具的基础。

## Node.js http 模块基础

### 创建最简单的 HTTP 服务器

```js
const http = require('node:http');
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
  res.end('Hello, World!');
});

server.listen(3000, () => {
  console.log('Server running at http://localhost:3000');
});
```

### 请求对象（IncomingMessage）

```js
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  console.log({
    method: req.method,           // GET / POST / PUT / DELETE
    url: req.url,                 // /path?query=string
    headers: req.headers,         // { host, 'user-agent', 'accept', ... }
    httpVersion: req.httpVersion,// 1.1
    socket: {
      remoteAddress: req.socket.remoteAddress,   // 客户端 IP
      remotePort: req.socket.remotePort          // 客户端端口
    }
  });
});
```

### 响应对象（ServerResponse）

```js
res.writeHead(statusCode, [statusHeaders]);     // 写入响应头
res.setHeader(name, value);                     // 设置单个头
res.getHeader(name);                            // 获取头部值
res.removeHeader(name);                         // 移除头部
res.write(chunk[, encoding][, callback]);       // 分块写入 body
res.end([data][, encoding][, callback]);        // 结束响应（含可选数据）
res.statusCode = 404;                           // 直接设置状态码
res.statusMessage = 'Not Found';                // 自定义状态消息
```

## 静态文件服务器

### 完整实现

```js
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const http = require('node:http');

// MIME 类型映射表
const MIME_TYPES = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
  '.css':  'text/css; charset=utf-8',
  '.js':   'application/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
  '.png':  'image/png',
  '.jpg':  'image/jpeg',
  '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg',
  '.gif':  'image/gif',
  '.svg':  'image/svg+xml',
  '.ico':  'image/x-icon',
  '.webp': 'image/webp',
  '.wav':  'audio/wav',
  '.mp4':  'video/mp4',
  '.woff': 'font/woff',
  '.woff2': 'font/woff2',
  '.ttf':  'font/ttf',
  '.eot':  'application/vnd.ms-fontobject',
  '.otf':  'font/otf',
  '.wasm':  'application/wasm',
  '.pdf':  'application/pdf',
  '.ts':   'application/typescript; charset=utf-8',
  '.tsx':  'application/typescript-jsx; charset=utf-8',
  '.map':  'application/json',
};

function getMimeType(filePath) {
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
  return MIME_TYPES[ext] || 'application/octet-stream';
}

const PUBLIC_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, 'public');

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  // 安全检查：防止路径遍历攻击
  const requestedPath = path.normalize(req.url.split('?')[0]);
  const filePath = path.join(PUBLIC_DIR, requestedPath);

  if (!filePath.startsWith(PUBLIC_DIR)) {
    res.statusCode = 403;
    res.end('Forbidden');
    return;
  }

  // 默认返回 index.html
  const finalPath = filePath.endsWith(path.sep)
    ? path.join(filePath, 'index.html')
    : filePath;

  fs.readFile(finalPath, (err, data) => {
    if (err) {
      if (err.code === 'ENOENT') {
        // 文件不存在 → 尝试返回 SPA fallback（index.html）
        const indexPath = path.join(PUBLIC_DIR, 'index.html');
        fs.readFile(indexPath, (idxErr, idxData) => {
          if (idxErr) {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
            res.end('404 Not Found');
          } else {
            res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' });
            res.end(idxData);
          }
        });
      } else if (err.code === 'EACCES') {
        res.writeHead(403, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
        res.end('Forbidden');
      } else {
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
        res.end('Internal Server Error');
      }
      return;
    }

    const contentType = getMimeType(finalPath);
    res.writeHead(200, {
      'Content-Type': contentType,
      'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',           // 开发环境禁用缓存
    });
    res.end(data);
  });
});

server.listen(3000, () => {
  console.log('Dev server running at http://localhost:3000');
});
```

### 使用 Stream 优化大文件传输

```js
const fs = require('node:fs');

// 小文件用 readFile（< 100KB）
fs.readFile(filePath, (err, data) => { res.end(data); });

// 大文件用 Stream（避免内存溢出）
const stream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
stream.pipe(res);

stream.on('error', (err) => {
  if (err.code === 'ENOENT') {
    res.statusCode = 404;
    res.end('Not Found');
  } else {
    res.statusCode = 500;
    res.end('Internal Error');
  }
});

// 支持断点续传（Range 请求）
const stat = fs.statSync(filePath);
const fileSize = stat.size;
const range = req.headers.range;

if (range) {
  const parts = range.replace(/bytes=/, '').split('-');
  const start = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
  const end = parts[1] ? parseInt(parts[1], 10) : fileSize - 1;
  const chunkSize = end - start + 1;

  res.writeHead(206, {
    'Content-Range': `bytes ${start}-${end}/${fileSize}`,
    'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes',
    'Content-Length': chunkSize,
    'Content-Type': getMimeType(filePath),
  });

  fs.createReadStream(filePath, { start, end }).pipe(res);
} else {
  res.writeHead(200, {
    'Content-Length': fileSize,
    'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes',
    'Content-Type': getMimeType(filePath),
  });

  fs.createReadStream(filePath).pipe(res);
}
```

## 路由分发

### 基础路由匹配

```js
const routes = {
  'GET /api/users': handleGetUsers,
  'POST /api/users': handleCreateUser,
  'GET /api/users/:id': handleGetUser,
  'PUT /api/users/:id': handleUpdateUser,
  'DELETE /api/users/:id': handleDeleteUser,
};

function matchRoute(method, url) {
  for (const [pattern, handler] of Object.entries(routes)) {
    const [routeMethod, routePath] = pattern.split(' ');
    if (routeMethod !== method) continue;

    // 将 :param 转为正则捕获组
    const paramNames = [];
    const regexStr = routePath.replace(/:(\w+)/g, (_, name) => {
      paramNames.push(name);
      return '([^/]+)';
    });
    const regex = new RegExp(`^${regexStr}$`);
    const match = url.pathname.match(regex);

    if (match) {
      const params = {};
      paramNames.forEach((name, i) => params[name] = match[i + 1]);
      return { handler, params };
    }
  }
  return null;
}
```

### 路由器完整实现

```js
class Router {
  constructor() {
    this.routes = [];
  }

  register(method, pattern, handler) {
    const keys = [];
    const regexStr = pattern.replace(/:(\w+)/g, (_, key) => {
      keys.push(key);
      return '([^/]+)';
    });
    this.routes.push({ method, regex: new RegExp(`^${regexStr}$`), handler, keys });
  }

  get(pattern, handler) { this.register('GET', pattern, handler); }
  post(pattern, handler) { this.register('POST', pattern, handler); }
  put(pattern, handler) { this.register('PUT', pattern, handler); }
  delete(pattern, handler) { this.register('DELETE', pattern, handler); }

  resolve(req) {
    const url = new URL(req.url, `http://${req.headers.host}`);
    for (const route of this.routes) {
      if (route.method !== req.method) continue;
      const match = url.pathname.match(route.regex);
      if (match) {
        const params = {};
        route.keys.forEach((key, i) => params[key] = decodeURIComponent(match[i + 1]));
        return { handler: route.handler, params, query: Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams) };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
}

// 使用
const router = new Router();
router.get('/api/users/:id', (req, res, { params }) => {
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  res.end(JSON.stringify({ id: params.id, name: 'Alice' }));
});

// 在服务器中使用
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const match = router.resolve(req);
  if (match) {
    match.handler(req, res, match);
  } else {
    res.writeHead(404);
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Not Found' }));
  }
});
```

### 解析请求体（JSON / URL-encoded）

```js
function parseBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', chunk => chunks.push(chunk));
    req.on('end', () => {
      const buffer = Buffer.concat(chunks);
      const type = req.headers['content-type'] || '';
      
      if (type.includes('application/json')) {
        try { resolve(JSON.parse(buffer.toString())); }
        catch { reject(new Error('Invalid JSON')); }
      } else if (type.includes('application/x-www-form-urlencoded')) {
        resolve(Object.fromEntries(
          new URLSearchParams(buffer.toString()).entries()
        ));
      } else {
        resolve(buffer.toString());
      }
    });
    req.on('error', reject);
  });
}

// POST 处理示例
router.post('/api/users', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const body = await parseBody(req);
    res.writeHead(201, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: body }));
  } catch (err) {
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }));
  }
});
```

## 返回 HTML / CSS / JS 的细节

### HTML 响应

```js
function sendHTML(res, content) {
  res.writeHead(200, {
    'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
    'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
  });
  res.end(content);
}
```

### CSS 响应（支持 Source Map）

```js
function sendCSS(res, cssContent, sourceMap) {
  let content = cssContent;
  if (sourceMap) {
    content += `\n/*# sourceMappingURL=${sourceMap} */`;
  }
  res.writeHead(200, {
    'Content-Type': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
    'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
  });
  res.end(content);
}
```

### JS 响应（ESM / CJS）

```js
function sendJS(res, jsContent, moduleType = 'module') {
  res.writeHead(200, {
    'Content-Type': 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8',
    'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
    ...(moduleType === 'module'
      ? { 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff' }
      : {}
    ),
  });
  res.end(jsContent);
}
```

### SPA Fallback 模式

```js
// 对于非 API 请求且文件不存在的情况，返回 index.html
function serveSPA(res) {
  const indexPath = path.join(PUBLIC_DIR, 'index.html');
  fs.readFile(indexPath, (err, data) => {
    if (err) {
      res.writeHead(500);
      res.end('Server Error');
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(200, {
      'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
    });
    res.end(data);
  });
}
```

## 小结

| 要点 | 关键 API |
|------|---------|
| 创建服务器 | `http.createServer(handler)` |
| 请求信息 | `req.method`, `req.url`, `req.headers` |
| 发送响应 | `res.writeHead()`, `res.end()` |
| 静态文件 | `fs.createReadStream().pipe(res)` |
| MIME 类型 | 根据扩展名映射 Content-Type |
| 路由匹配 | 正则提取路径参数 |
| Body 解析 | 监听 `data`/`end` 事件拼接 Buffer |
| Range 支持 | `Accept-Ranges`, `206 Partial Content` |
